text: Every week, a patient leaves your office without the treatment you know they need. Not because you were wrong. Because of how the conversation went.
Clozer Clinic is a flight simulator for that conversation.
Your stations. Shockwave, laser, orthotics — loaded with your services, at your prices.
You walk into the room and talk to an A.I. patient who pushes back like a real one.
The moment you finish, you're graded on the five things that decide a case: rapport, clinical framing, price delivery, objections, and the close.
Every rep shows you the exact line that cost you — and the line that would have won it.
Then it follows you into the real chair. Closed revenue. Where consults leak. What the training is actually worth.
Clozer Clinic. Get the yes you already earned.
